name: LeverageSIR
fix_description: Storage slot collision: two variables in the proxy/implementation layout map to the same storage slot, causing data to be overwritten unexpectedly. This corrupts critical state used in uniswapV3SwapCallback. Fix: reorganize storage layout to eliminate slot collisions, using explicit slot assignments or OpenZeppelin storage gap patterns.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires a non-obvious multi-step exploit chain: crafting fake ERC20-like tokens, initializing a Uniswap V3 pool/position, manipulating transient storage/state via a specific mint path, deploying a contract at a computed CREATE2 address to satisfy callback assumptions, and then draining multiple assets through direct callback abuse. Exploiting it demands deep understanding of protocol-specific vault logic, Uniswap V3 callback mechanics, address/salt engineering, and custom calldata construction, which is well beyond a straightforward auditor write-up.
